auraFreeze.rule: No Aura regeneration, alteration, remap or re-review unless a later exact-hash defect is recorded.

referenceBasis.mobileRule: Responsive captures prove hierarchy/readability/static-state quality only; never claim mobile pixel parity.

purpose: Give Workstream 15 an implementation target and Workstream 14 a deterministic still-capture acceptance packet for reduced-motion visual quality without creating runtime state or closing any gate by source inspection.

mustBeAbsent: animated backdrop filters on dense or scrolling surfaces
celebratory treatment on wrong, clue or retry states

materialLanguage.rule: Use fixed rim/keyline/contact-shadow/material contrast to preserve premium depth when motion is disabled.

occlusion: Avatar face and equipped item silhouette stay unobscured.
Item names, prices, answer copy, CTA text and focus rings stay above decorative effects.
Static stars/glints must sit outside critical text bands.
No decorative layer may intercept pointer or focus input.

requiredStillStates.semanticPrerequisite: ordinary Home state with real room progression loaded
visualRequirements: All five truthful room-tier previews are visible immediately in final positions.
Only the true current tier may receive warm-gold emphasis; locked tiers preserve truthful lock treatment.
Room Progress and Dream Goal may carry fixed cyan/ice depth; no pulse.
Avatar and Buddy are completely still but retain fixed contact shadow/rim light.
Daily Quests, Customize and learning copy remain calmer than hero anchors and fully readable.
failIf: Any tile waits for an animation callback to become visible.
Fake unlock/progress material is introduced.
Static effect treatment covers the avatar face or instructional copy.
Reduced-motion mode merely removes depth and makes premium anchors visually flat.

viewportAdaptation.1408x1056: Use normalized reference geometry as the desktop authority.
viewportAdaptation.1024x768: Preserve hero hierarchy; effects remain localized to Room Progress/Dream Goal, never expanded to compensate for tighter space.
viewportAdaptation.390x844: Suppress any optional decorative star cluster that would collide with copy; state cues rely on rim/keyline/contact shadow.
viewportAdaptation.320x568: Maximum restraint: no decorative cluster is required; truthful room/current-state material and readable avatar/copy take priority.

requiredStillStates.semanticPrerequisite: existing selected item state is true
visualRequirements: Exact selected card has a persistent stronger cyan/ice rim without resizing or shifting neighbors.
Try-on/detail destination has one fixed soft halo.
No card-to-stage travel path, scale bounce or pulse exists.
Item name, price and selected/equipped semantic cues remain above decoration.
failIf: Selection is only understandable from an animation that is absent.
Fixed halo washes neighboring card labels or prices.
Grid geometry changes when reduced motion is enabled.

visualRequirements: Persistent equipped cue remains the primary source of truth.
Optional fixed three-to-five-star cluster sits near destination art but outside face/item-critical detail.
No success implication is shown before the existing equip state is true.
failIf: Equipped state depends on particle motion.
Static cluster obscures the avatar face or newly equipped object.
Reduced-motion style changes ownership, price, purchase or save semantics.

requiredStillStates.semanticPrerequisite: selected/equipped state remains true after one meaningful grid scroll
visualRequirements: Persistent selected/equipped material remains legible before and after scroll.
No orphan particle or animated filter layer appears during scroll.
Scroll position is not changed by effect material.
failIf: Selection glow changes intensity because the grid moved.
A decorative overlay detaches from its owning card/stage.
Scrolling becomes visually muddy from large soft filters.

viewportAdaptation.1408x1056: Reference-density target remains six columns by three full rows; static effect treatment cannot reduce density.
viewportAdaptation.1024x768: Selected/equipped cue must remain visible without increasing blur spill into adjacent cards.
viewportAdaptation.390x844: Prefer outline/keyline over halo spread; optional star cluster may be omitted if it competes with item art or text.
viewportAdaptation.320x568: Use the strongest non-motion semantic cue and minimal decorative glow; never trade label/price readability for spectacle.

visualRequirements: Central learning body is visually calm and all answer choices remain neutral.
No choice receives gold, green success or attention-steering sparkle.
Avatar/mastery chrome may keep static depth but no urgency treatment.
failIf: Any visual cue hints at the correct answer before correctness is established.
A pulsing or motion-derived emphasis has been replaced by an equally biasing static glow.
Countdown, streak-loss or FOMO visual language appears.

visualRequirements: Correct state uses an instant static green success keyline.
Optional small fixed gold/ice star cluster sits outside answer copy.
Question/answer geometry does not move and next action remains immediately available.
failIf: Correct styling depends on a transient animation.
Static decoration covers passage or answer text.
Success appears before the existing correct semantic state is true.

requiredStillStates.semanticPrerequisite: existing wrong, clue or retry state
visualRequirements: Instructional feedback remains readable.
There is zero gold reward flare, Star Spark cluster, success bloom or celebratory avatar reaction.
Assisted/clue treatment remains visibly distinct from independent correct success where existing semantics provide that distinction.
failIf: Wrong/clue/retry can be mistaken for success.
Celebration material survives from a previous correct state.
Static treatment reveals the answer rather than preserving existing instructional semantics.

requiredStillStates.semanticPrerequisite: advance from a prior correct state to the next unanswered state
visualRequirements: All previous success decoration is gone before the new unanswered frame is judged.
New answer choices are neutral and visually equivalent absent existing semantic differences.
failIf: Any green/gold success residue survives into the next question.
A stale effect layer changes focus, geometry or answer salience.

viewportAdaptation.1408x1056: Use normalized reference hierarchy and keep the central lesson/question body the calmest large region.
viewportAdaptation.1024x768: Maintain state contrast with keylines rather than larger glow fields.
viewportAdaptation.390x844: Prefer zero decorative stars if needed to protect answer readability; correct/wrong distinction must survive through static color/material cues.
viewportAdaptation.320x568: No optional spectacle is required; neutral unanswered choices and unmistakable non-celebratory wrong/clue/retry states are mandatory.

renderQaHandoff.capturePolicy: Capture actual rendered pixels for every required still state at the listed viewports. Source/CSS inspection cannot close the gate.

comparisonPolicy.desktop: Compare composition/material hierarchy against the normalized authoritative desktop reference while accounting for truthful state/content differences.
comparisonPolicy.responsive: Judge readability, hierarchy, occlusion, cleanup and effect restraint only; no invented mobile parity claim.

stateIntegrityChecks: No motion-only information disappears in reduced motion.
No success decoration appears in Quest wrong/clue/retry.
No stale success decoration remains on the next unanswered Quest frame.
Store selected/equipped cues remain visible after scroll without changing scroll position.
Home room tiles are all available immediately and remain truthful to real state.
No decorative overlay blocks pointer, focus, text or critical illustration detail.
